# Draft:Mong of The Year Awards

----
The Mong of The Year Award is a prestigious and unique event issued by the Whitewebbs Vets Football team. Held on an annual basis, as part of the end of season celebrations, players are awarded trophies in recognition of their incredible individual contributions throughout the football season. After awards are given out for player of the year, top goal scorer and clubman, the highlight award is and will always be The Mong of The Year awards.
Though this award is typically difficult to defend, there is currently an outright leader.
Past Winners:
2001 to 2019 - Travis White
2020 - No contest due to COVID
2021 to 2024 - Travis White
Current Holder - Travis White
